title: PeRFlow: Piecewise Rectified Flow as Universal Plug-and-Play Accelerator
tldr_zh: 4 时间窗内对真实图像加噪做短程 reflow，免整轨迹合成、可在线训练；ΔW 即插即用加速 SD 生态，4 步 FID 优于 LCM-LoRA
tldr_en: Piecewise reflow within 4 time windows starting from noised real images avoids full-trajectory synthesis; the weight delta plugs into SD pipelines, beating LCM-LoRA at 4 steps.
